messages:
incident-bot: Paging ryan_oncall: Severity 2 - High tail latency and streaming stalls observed in eu-west-1 affecting customer streaming sessions. Alert: p99 lat > 1200ms for last 5m. See: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/1769501234
ryan_oncall: ack. I'm on it. Gathering context — pulling dashboards now.
elaine_sre: I see p95 ~ 350ms but p99 is spiking to 1.5s. Streaming stalls show up as long gaps in websocket writes, not just token latency.
mohit_net: Any signs of cross AZ traffic? Recent routing changes?
ryan_oncall: Checking flow logs. Looks like a rise in cross-zone NATed connections from worker pools to model hosts in other AZs. Packet retransmits up.
elaine_sre: Repro: curl to /v1/stream -> initial handshake 200-300ms, then long pauses mid-stream. Logs show TLS handshake retries ~1.5s for some clients.
mohit_net: That screams NAT port exhaustion or SYN retries + path MTU maybe. Can you paste the tcpdump of a stall?
ryan_oncall: Attaching extract: ```
17:32:11.123456 IP 10.2.45.12.443 > 10.0.3.101.56922: Flags [P.], seq 1:1025, ack 1, win 32768, length 1024
17:32:12.654321 IP 10.2.45.12.443 > 10.0.3.101.56922: Flags [P.], seq 1025:2049, ack 1, length 1024
...
17:32:20.001000 IP 10.2.45.12.443 > 10.0.3.101.56922: Flags [P.], seq 2049:3073, ack 1, length 1024
```
ryan_oncall: Note the gap ~7s between packets.
sophia_prod_support: We have a customer on a call complaining that their real-time chat sessions are freezing. Impacted customers: corp-acme and fastchat. The CS playbook says to escalate at 15m if stalls persist. We're at 6m.
elaine_sre: I rolled a temporary increase to streaming write timeouts to avoid user-visible disconnects, but that's just masking. We need to reduce tail latency.
mohit_net: Running traceroute and nat metrics now. Preliminary from worker subnet -> model host shows a jump in hops crossing AZ routing gateway. NAT gateway error counters increased by ~1800/min. Also seeing TLS handshake spikes: SYN->ACK delayed by ~900ms on average for affected flows.
ryan_oncall: Can we fail traffic to an alternate path or region? Devoted fallback policy exists but switching region may cost state.
mohit_net: We can shift a subset of traffic via eu-central-1 in the routing tier for new sessions. For in-flight streams, we'll attempt connection affinity draining with longer keepalive.
elaine_sre: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Temporarily increase NAT gateway capacity by scaling additional NAT instances, 2) Enable sticky routing to avoid cross-AZ traversal for new sessions, 3) Disable aggressive TLS renegotiation on model hosts.
sophia_prod_support: I'll tell customers we're investigating and may reroute new sessions; will avoid telling them about region moves until we confirm.
ryan_oncall: Action 1: deploy-bot, can you spin up +2 NAT instances in eu-west-1 now? Tag: incident-1769501234.
deploy-bot: accepted. Spawning nat-gw-eu-1a-02 and nat-gw-eu-1b-02. ETA ~ 90s. Logs: instance provisioning -> configuring SNAT rules.
mohit_net: While that comes up, I'm enabling connection tracking tuning to extend ephemeral port range and reduce TIME_WAIT recycling. Command I'm running on gateways: ```sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 65000"; sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1```
elaine_sre: I'm disabling TLS renegotiation and bumping write buffer sizes on the runtime: ```/etc/redwood/runtime.conf: tls_renegotiation=false
stream_write_buffer=64k```
ryan_oncall: Metrics update?
elaine_sre: After these changes: p99 down from 1.5s -> 720ms in 2m, streaming gap tail reduced to ~3s for majority. NAT errors decreased after new instances came online.
sophia_prod_support: Customers reporting partial recovery. corp-acme session resumed after ~10s freeze. I'll keep CS updated.
mohit_net: Running a targeted tcpdump and eBPF traces on the old gateways to capture retransmit queues for postmortem. Saving captures to s3://incidents/1769501234/pcap.
ryan_oncall: Good. We need to hand off to next oncall in 45m. Elaine, Mohit, please prepare mitigation notes, and list follow-ups:"Scale NAT autoscaling policy, investigate why TLS handshake spiked (packet loss vs gateway queuing), consider moving model routing to eliminate cross-AZ NAT hops, add more robust connection draining for streaming sessions"
elaine_sre: I'll own TLS investigation and mitigations (root cause hypothesis: NAT queueing causing delayed SYN/ACK and triggering client-side TLS retries), will add an eval to test 1MB streaming bursts across AZs.
mohit_net: I'll own network follow-ups: ASG scaling thresholds, increase NAT concurrent connections limits, and add enhanced flow logging for peak times.
sophia_prod_support: I'll coordinate customer comms and set expectations for SLO breaches: our SLA-aware tracker shows potential SLA hit for corp-acme for p99 during incident window.
ryan_oncall: I'm adding incident timeline to #postmortems and creating a pagerduty follow-up. Handoff: @jen_next_oncall you'll get the page in 45m, please be ready.
incident-bot: Note: next on-call override message scheduled for 1769504054.
ryan_oncall: Summary for handoff: incident triggered by tail latency due to NAT gateway saturation causing cross-AZ queuing and TLS handshake delays -> mitigation: scale NAT, tune port range and tcp reuse, disable TLS renegotiation, enable sticky routing for new sessions. Current state: degraded but stabilizing.
sophia_prod_support: Marking incident status: investigating -> mitigated for customer-visible impact. Will move to resolved once postmortem is scheduled.
elaine_sre: Uploading logs and traces: s3://incidents/1769501234/logs.zip and s3://incidents/1769501234/tcpdump.pcap.
mohit_net: Quick note — we observed 2% packet loss on the primary routing gateway during the spike window. That aligns with retransmits.
ryan_oncall: Thanks all. Postmortem owners: elaine_sre, mohit_net. I'll keep the incident open until the draft is posted.
sophia_prod_support: Thx. Looping in sales for corp-acme heads-up.
deploy-bot: NAT instances nat-gw-eu-1a-02 and nat-gw-eu-1b-02 healthy.
incident-bot: Incident channel updated. Severity downgraded to S3.
ryan_oncall: End of thread for now — handing off to next oncall in 45m. Keep updates in this thread.
